main_text.p: las, contra Apostolorum instituta, contra veteris Ecclesiæ morem, contra manifestissima Conciliorum decreta, contra patrum clarissimas vbique refragationes (Deo & hominibus plane renitentibus) Christianorum basilicæ nihilò seciùs, ac Gentilium templa, simulachris vndique replean-tur? vt (quod olim questus est Hieronymus) candor Ecclesiæ Ethnicorum sordibus polluatur; vt (quod Eusebius amentiæ merito insimulat) Deo invisibili & incorporeo, imago visibilis & corporea statuatur; vt in Agnis Dei, granis, luminibus, rosis, gladijs, insigni-

page.notes: The text is printed in two frames; the final word "bus," sits below the rule and is counted as printed. Faint show-through and stains at the upper left margin were left out. The marginal note "Hier.Magno Orat. Rom." is set in italic and small type, and its exact placement is approximate. Catchword shown is the word below the last line. Some letters are uncertain due to scan quality.
